components.name: DataGrid
components.introduction: Native ReUI data grid with caller-owned TanStack state and columns.
components.guidance: Create a controller with useTable({ features: dataGridFeatures, data, columns, getRowId, state, ...handlers }). Compose DataGridTable inside DataGridScrollArea. Use DataGridColumnHeader for sorting, DataGridPagination for pagination, and DataGridContainer or Frame for the surface. For row selection, enableRowSelection, provide stable domain IDs through getRowId, and compose DataGridTableRowSelectAll (no props) and DataGridTableRowSelect in the selection column. Client pagination uses zero-based state.pagination.pageIndex. Server pagination also requires manualPagination: true and rowCount: total in useTable. Configure resizing through the table's columnResizeMode option. Keep data loading and mutations in the View. Use isLoading for skeleton rows; emptyMessage accepts an Empty component with a recovery action or a request error with Retry.

components.name: Filters
components.introduction: Native ReUI filter builder with caller-owned query state.
components.guidance: Initialize with createFilterQuery(). Callers own evaluation and persistence. flattenFilterConditions(query) drops group structure; traverse the original query for mixed AND/OR groups. Basic mode displays flat chips and cannot express group structure. Use advanced mode for nested queries. Field IDs must be unique among siblings and full field paths unique.

components.name: Frame
components.justification: Composes ReUI Frame sections behind flat title, description, action, and footer props with owned panel spacing.
components.introduction: A structured surface with an optional header and footer around one content panel.
components.guidance: Pass title, description, and a right-aligned action directly. The header is omitted when all three are absent; action alone creates a full-width header. Pass footer as JSX and panel content as children. Use padding="none" for edge-to-edge tables.

components.name: Input
components.introduction: A props-based input with native DOM events and internally associated labels and validation feedback.
components.guidance: Use label, description, and error instead of Field composition. Box owns width; Stack and Grid arrange controls. Validation and submission remain caller-owned; runtime failures belong to the error boundary. Use native date, time, and file input types. File inputs remain uncontrolled and files must be validated on the server.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Optional visible label, automatically associated with the input.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Supporting text associated through aria-describedby.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Caller-owned validation message; marks the input invalid.

properties.name: step
properties.description: Use "any" for decimals.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: DOM event; read event.currentTarget.value, or event.currentTarget.files for file inputs.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled value. File inputs remain uncontrolled.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled value.

properties.name: accept
properties.description: File picker hint; validate file types on the server.

properties.name: multiple
properties.description: Allows multiple file selections.

components.justification: Owns field labeling, validation feedback, and fixed presentation while retaining the installed native input.

components.name: Textarea
components.introduction: A props-based textarea with native DOM events and internally associated field feedback.

properties.name: error
properties.description: Caller-owned validation message.

properties.name: onChange
properties.description: DOM event; read event.currentTarget.value.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled value.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled value.

components.justification: Owns field presentation while preserving native textarea values, events, refs, and constraints.

components.name: Checkbox
components.introduction: A checkbox with an optional adjacent label and associated validation feedback.

properties.name: checked

properties.name: defaultChecked

properties.name: indeterminate

components.name: Map
components.justification: Preserves native mapcn composition while containing WebGL initialization failures and retry within the map region.
components.introduction: Native mapcn map container for composable geographic layers.
components.guidance: Place Map inside a Box with an explicit height. Map names the UI component; create JavaScript collections with new globalThis.Map(). Use blank for a transparent basemap with no street tiles, then compose MapGeoJSON inside it. The map follows the UI theme automatically. Coordinates use longitude, latitude. Inherits MapLibre MapOptions except container and style: https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js/docs/API/type-aliases/MapOptions/. Styling props and theme are not exposed. The bundled worker stays local; external map resources remain limited to the approved CARTO origins.

properties.name: viewport
properties.description: Controlled center [longitude, latitude], zoom, bearing, and pitch. Pair with onViewportChange for controlled camera updates.

properties.name: onViewportChange
properties.description: Continuously observes pan, zoom, rotation, and pitch; also usable without viewport.

properties.name: ref
properties.description: Access to the native MapLibre instance.

components.name: MapGeoJSON
components.introduction: Native mapcn GeoJSON fill and outline layer composed inside Map.
components.guidance: Render MapGeoJSON inside Map. Use Map blank for a boundary-only map. Pass parsed GeoJSON from your Solution to avoid remote source dependencies. Paint options use MapLibre expressions, and interaction callbacks retain the native mapcn event payload.

components.name: MapControls
components.introduction: Mapcn zoom, compass, browser location, and fullscreen controls.
components.guidance: Compose MapControls inside Map. Locate requests browser permission only when clicked and requires a secure context. Location and fullscreen remain subject to browser and iframe permission policies.

components.name: StreetMap
components.justification: Owns parent-controlled sizing, provider restrictions, accessible naming, and local failure recovery around mapcn.
components.introduction: One themed street map combining optional locations, routes, clusters, and connections.
components.guidance: Pass locations, routes, clusters, and connections together to render them on a single map. onSelectLocation handles location markers and individual unclustered points. Place in a Box with an explicit height. Coordinates use longitude, latitude. CARTO styles, tiles, sprites, and glyphs use fixed allowlisted endpoints without credentials. The worker is bundled locally. View code cannot provide arbitrary style URLs. Mouse-wheel zoom is enabled on interactive maps.

components.name: MarkerMap
components.justification: Builds accessible markers and text popups from caller-owned data while keeping mapcn composition inside the component.
components.introduction: Named locations with accessible marker buttons and text popups.
components.guidance: Pass data as MapMarker objects. IDs must be unique. Marker coordinates use longitude, latitude. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Locations with id, coordinates, label, and optional description.

components.name: RouteMap
components.justification: Validates and renders route collections through mapcn without requiring View-owned layer composition or external routing.
components.introduction: Route lines drawn from supplied longitude and latitude coordinates.
components.guidance: Pass data as MapRoute objects with unique IDs and at least two coordinate pairs. Route geometry comes from your Solution; no routing service is called. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

components.name: ClusterMap
components.justification: Converts named locations to clustered GeoJSON and maps selected features back to caller-owned records.
components.introduction: Nearby locations grouped into expandable clusters.
components.guidance: Pass the same MapMarker data used by MarkerMap. Clicking a cluster zooms in; onSelect receives individual locations. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

components.name: ArcMap
components.justification: Validates geographic connection data and owns mapcn arc composition and selection.
components.introduction: Curved connections between geographic origins and destinations.
components.guidance: Pass MapArc data with unique IDs, from, and to coordinates. Size with Box. Supports the same map options as StreetMap.

components.name: ChartLegend
components.introduction: Renders a standalone chart legend in a card footer or another layout region.
components.guidance: Set legend={false} on the chart. For area, bar, line, and radar charts, pass the same series in the same order. For pie and radial charts, pass the same data and nameKey in the same order. Colors follow the chart theme; no chart context is needed. Empty legends render nothing.

properties.name: formatValue
properties.description: Formats values when valueKey is supplied.

components.justification: Owns a context-independent legend with the same ordered theme colors as LongLink charts.

components.name: LineChart
components.introduction: Plots numeric line series without joining missing data points.
components.guidance: Place inside a Box with an explicit height. Supply xKey and series keys from your row data. Null values leave gaps; zero values are preserved. Loading and retry belong to the caller.

components.name: PieChart
components.introduction: Shows nonnegative contributions as themed doughnut segments.
components.guidance: Place inside a Box with an explicit height. Supply label and numeric value keys. Empty data or a zero total displays No data; invalid segment values are rejected.

components.name: RadarChart
components.introduction: Compares numeric series across named categories on polar axes.
components.guidance: Place inside a Box with an explicit height. Supply categoryKey and numeric series keys. Presentation is owned by the component.

components.name: RadialBarChart

components.guidance: Place inside a Box with an explicit height. Set max to the actual scale limit, such as 100 for percentages. Values must be between zero and max; zeros remain valid data.

components.name: Box

Padding uses theme spacing units, like Stack. Inline and block padding override padding, including zero. Omitted backgrounds remain transparent. Native div attributes and events are supported without refs or styling overrides.

components.name: Card
components.introduction: A standalone card with optional header and footer content and accessible surface interactions.
components.guidance: Pass title, description, and a right-aligned action directly. The header is omitted when all three are absent; action alone creates a full-width header. Pass footer as JSX and body content as children. Supply label with onClick, href, or onChange for interactive cards. Selection takes priority over onClick and href; nested controls remain independent. Use Box for sizing.

components.name: Dialog
components.justification: Owns modal composition, responsive sizing, body scrolling, and dismissal while Base UI retains focus management and isolated View host coordination.

members.name: useForm(path, options?)
members.description: React Hook Form with scoped Solution submission. Options: schema (Zod), defaultValues, method (POST by default; also PUT, PATCH, DELETE), onSuccess, onError. Use <Form onSubmit={form.onSubmit} noValidate> with a schema; use register for native inputs and Controller for composite controls. Existing React Hook Form APIs remain available. Await form.submit(values) or form.submit(formData) for direct actions; form.submit() submits current values or an empty payload when no fields are configured. A schema validates and supplies parsed values before submission. Invalid values reject submission and populate field errors. Submission failures reject unless onError handles them; omit onError when a confirmation must stay open on failure. Read pending state from formState.isSubmitting, field errors from formState.errors, and submission errors from formState.errors.root. Strings stay strings; numbers and booleans become strings; File and Blob remain binary. Arrays create repeated multipart entries, nullish values are omitted, and nested objects are unsupported. With a schema, FormData fields become scalars for single entries and arrays for repeated entries; submit an object to preserve single-item arrays. Successful writes refresh cached View data before onSuccess. Drafts remain until reset; validate and authorize again on the server.

members.name: useState(initial)
members.description: Returns the current state and a setter. Pass a value or an initializer function; updates can use the previous state.

members.name: useEffect(effect, dependencies)
members.description: Synchronizes with external systems after rendering. Return a cleanup function to release timers or subscriptions. Include every reactive value used by the effect in its dependencies.

members.name: useMemo(factory, dependencies)
members.description: Caches a calculated value until its dependencies change. Use it for expensive calculations, not required application state.

members.name: useRef(initial)
members.description: Returns a stable object with a mutable current property. Changing current does not trigger a render.

members.name: useApi(path)
members.description: Returns Solution data and an awaitable invalidator scoped to the full request path. The renderer handles initial loading, errors, and retry.

members.name: useConfirm()
members.description: Returns show(options), hide(), isOpen, and element; render element once in JSX. Options require title, actionLabel, and onAction: () => void | Promise<void>. Optional description, cancelLabel (default Cancel), and actionVariant: default | destructive (default default). Cancel receives initial focus; Escape cancels and backdrop clicks do not dismiss. Async actions show loading, prevent duplicate submissions, and close only after success. Failure keeps the dialog open for retry; scoped request errors are reported by the host, other errors appear inside the dialog. While pending, Cancel, Escape, show(), and hide() are ignored. Example: const confirmation = useConfirm(); const form = useForm('/api/variants'); confirmation.show({ title: 'Conferma variante A', cancelLabel: 'Annulla', actionLabel: 'Continua', onAction: async () => { await form.submit({ variant: 'A' }); } }); Render {confirmation.element} beside the trigger Button.

components.name: Table
components.introduction: Displays semantic tables with fixed styling, optional text wrapping, and cell alignment.
components.guidance: Compose TableHeader (thead), TableBody (tbody), and TableFooter (tfoot) with TableRow (tr) children. Use TableHead (th) for headers, TableCell (td) for data, and TableCaption (caption) for the table description. Each part accepts its native HTML attributes, events, and ref, excluding styling overrides and dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Set scope on header cells and colSpan or rowSpan for spanning cells. Use ReUI DataGrid for sorting, selection, and pagination.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Table parts with standard HTML attributes, events, and refs; styling overrides are excluded.

properties.name: wrap
properties.description: Wraps cell text instead of keeping it on one line.

properties.name: TableHeader.children
properties.description: Header rows rendered inside thead.

properties.name: TableBody.children
properties.description: Data rows rendered inside tbody.

properties.name: TableFooter.children
properties.description: Summary rows rendered inside tfoot.

properties.name: TableRow.children
properties.description: Header or data cells rendered inside tr.

properties.name: TableHead.children
properties.description: Header cell content.

properties.name: TableHead.scope
properties.description: Identifies the cells described by this header.

properties.name: TableHead.align
properties.description: Header text alignment.

properties.name: TableCell.children
properties.description: Data cell content.

properties.name: TableCell.align
properties.description: Cell text alignment.

properties.name: TableHead.colSpan / rowSpan
properties.description: Native header cell column or row span.

properties.name: TableCell.colSpan / rowSpan
properties.description: Native data cell column or row span.

properties.name: TableCaption.children
properties.description: Accessible table description, displayed below the table.

components.justification: Provides fixed table styling with explicit wrapping and logical alignment while preserving native table semantics.

components.name: Tabs
components.introduction: Switches between related content panels.
components.guidance: Pass tab records through items. Each item supplies a stable string value, a label, and its panel content. The first enabled item is selected when defaultValue is omitted.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Tab records containing values, labels, and panel content.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: Initial uncontrolled selection; defaults to the first enabled item's value.

properties.name: onValueChange
properties.description: Receives the selected value without library event details.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Controlled selection.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Tab list appearance.

properties.name: items[].disabled
properties.description: Whether the tab is disabled.

properties.name: items[].value
properties.description: Stable selection value associating the tab with its panel.

properties.name: items[].label
properties.description: Visible tab label.

properties.name: items[].content
properties.description: Panel content mounted when selected.

properties.name: items[].keepMounted
properties.description: Keeps an inactive panel in the DOM.

components.justification: Builds tabs and panels from item records while retaining native selection, keyboard behavior, and fixed styling.

components.name: Text
components.introduction: Displays text with configurable typography, semantic tone, alignment, and optional truncation. Use Heading for titles.
components.guidance: Inherits surrounding typography unless size, weight, tone, or align is supplied. Use tone="muted" for supporting text and tone="destructive" for errors. Native HTML attributes, ARIA and data attributes, and event handlers are forwarded without styling overrides.

properties.name: as
properties.description: Renders inline text or a semantic paragraph.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Text content.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Typography size; omitted values inherit.

properties.name: weight
properties.description: Font weight; omitted values inherit.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: Semantic text color; omitted values inherit.

properties.name: align
properties.description: Text alignment; uses block layout so alignment uses the available width.

properties.name: tabularNums
properties.description: Uses equal-width numerals for aligned metrics.

properties.name: maxLines
properties.description: Maximum visible lines before truncation; 0 disables truncation.

components.justification: Provides prop-driven typography and line-count-based truncation on inline text or paragraphs; no Text primitive exists in shadcn/ui or ReUI.

components.name: Timestamp
components.introduction: Formats a date or timestamp using the standard date formats.
components.guidance: Accepts native span attributes and event handlers, without children or refs. Relative timestamps expose copyable absolute-date details. Component styling is fixed in Views.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The date/time to display. Accepts Unix timestamps (seconds) or ISO 8601 strings.

properties.name: format
properties.description: Date, time, relative, or Unix-seconds display format.

properties.name: timeZone
properties.description: IANA time zone for absolute formats, such as UTC. Defaults to the viewer's zone; relative details use their existing zones.

components.justification: Formats timestamps and relative times with viewer-locale details and copy controls.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.introduction: Native shadcn ButtonGroup composition with HTML div attributes.
components.guidance: Compose Button children with explicit size and disabled props. Use aria-label to name the group. ButtonGroupText adds a non-interactive label or value; its render prop can replace the default div. ButtonGroupSeparator divides controls: use its default vertical orientation in horizontal groups, or horizontal in vertical groups. All parts accept native attributes and refs without styling overrides or dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Connected control layout.

properties.name: aria-label
properties.description: Accessible group label.

properties.name: children
properties.description: Connected controls and companion parts.

properties.name: ButtonGroupText.children
properties.description: Non-interactive label or value displayed alongside controls.

properties.name: ButtonGroupText.render
properties.description: Replaces the default div while preserving the component's props.

properties.name: ButtonGroupSeparator.orientation
properties.description: Divider direction, perpendicular to the group layout.

patterns.name: Confirmation
patterns.description: Ask for Continue or Cancel before a scoped Solution operation, without managing dialog-open state.
steps: Call useConfirm() at the top level and render its element once beside the trigger Button.
Call show({ title, actionLabel, cancelLabel, onAction }) from the trigger. Description is optional; use translated labels when needed.

Call useForm(path, options) at the top level, then await form.submit(values) inside onAction. Use form.submit() for an empty action or pass FormData directly. Successful actions dismiss automatically; failures stay open for retry.

patterns.name: Data table
patterns.description: Present searchable records using data-driven rows and explicit query state.
steps: Load records with the documented Hooks API and keep search/filter state local.
Define Table columns and row actions using supported props; apply filtering or pagination on the server when needed.
Use Empty with a title and optional description and actions when there are no matching records.

patterns.name: Editing form
patterns.description: Collect intent through named fields and persist changes through a validated Solution route.
steps: Call useForm(path, { schema, defaultValues, onSuccess }) and render <Form onSubmit={form.onSubmit} noValidate>.
Use register for native inputs and Controller for composite controls, choosing fields that match the server schema.
Read pending state from formState.isSubmitting and display formState.errors, including errors.root for submission failures. The Solution route must validate input and enforce authorization.

patterns.name: Approval queue
patterns.description: Show pending work and make the next authorized action clear.
steps: Load pending records with the documented Hooks API and display their states as Table rows with Badge values.
Add explicit approve/reject actions through Button callbacks and scoped requests.
Enforce transitions and permissions on the Solution server, then refresh the queue after a successful action.
